text: Heavy aircraft are not to be given clearance or instructions that would require the use of more than normal power for taxiing or for entry onto the runway. Heavy aircraft, when at the holding point, are not to be cleared for an immediate takeoff. Question. Which category of aircraft can be cleared to takeoff immediately?
